overview:
**Fire danger is Low today, kept in check by overnight rain and cool, cloudy conditions moving through the area.**
- Danger holds Low through Wednesday, then climbs to Moderate Thursday–Sunday as ERC and BI percentiles rise into the mid‑50s.
- Showers and thunderstorms tonight (80% chance) and Wednesday will bring more moisture before skies clear and NNE winds pick up into the weekend.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met, and no Red Flag Warning is posted; NWS Grand Junction has an active Hydrologic Outlook for the region.
- Stage 1 Fire Restrictions are in effect in unincorporated Montrose County starting on 09/04/2026, and Stage One fire restrictions are in place in all of unincorporated San Miguel County as of August 21.
- Gunnison Field Office Stage 2 restrictions were lifted August 20, with Stage 1 remaining in effect through Dec. 31, 2026 across BLM lands in the area's counties.
- No uncontained wildfires are reported in or near these counties in today's national situation report.
